values.note: Book on CampLife, by phone or at the park office; the year's reservations open on the first business day after January 1. A single weekend night is allowed once the two-night rule is met for that site. Check-in and check-out 3 pm. Fees can also be paid at the self-registration station.

booking.source: Reservation Policy.pdf ('Campsite reservations will be accepted ... starting at 8:00 a.m., on the first legal business day after January 1st for the current calendar year'; 'Reservations that include a Friday or a Saturday night must be a minimum of TWO nights'; 'holiday weekends (Memorial Day, Independence Day, and Labor Day) must be a minimum of THREE nights'; 'Weekend reservations for a single night are allowed if #1 or #2 have previously been met for that campsite'; 'Reservations may be made for up to 14 consecutive days'; 'Campsite check-in and check-out time is 3:00 p.m.'); Campinfo 2025.pdf ('Reservations at CampLife.com'; 'Park fees are collected year-round by park staff, or at the self-registration station'); park page 'Reserve Campsite' -> camplife.com/campground/Nugget Lake County Park
